request_summary: Decide how Markdown document previews should behave when the spec is not explicit.
comparison_evidence: The spec says Markdown documents should be readable in the UI, but it does not define full-preview versus excerpt behavior.
The source currently displays an excerpt to keep the dashboard dense.

issues.summary: The spec does not define Markdown preview length or whether the dashboard should show full text.
issues.observed_spec_behavior: Preview should be readable, but no length or expansion behavior is specified.
issues.observed_source_behavior: Preview is capped to an excerpt.

questions.question: Should the dashboard show full Markdown content by default, a capped excerpt, or defer this decision?
questions.decision_impact: full updates source behavior; excerpt updates the spec with a cap; defer records the gap without changing behavior.
